set.body:
PURPOSE

Carry the StoryAtlas side of the external storymodel4s output-contract gate. The provider store is separate, so this local bead records provenance and adoption work without pretending a cross-store dependency edge exists.

EXTERNAL PROVENANCE

- storymodel4s epic: bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ.
- Independently accepted off-tree specification digest: 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f.
- At creation time, storymodel4s main e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a has no durable public implementation of the proposed output bundle and does not authorize StoryAtlas to bind draft names.

ENTRY GATE

A reviewed, authorized, reachable storymodel4s commit must expose the provider-owned contract and settle public vocabulary, dependency placement, failure behavior, provenance, and compatibility policy. An accepted document alone does not satisfy this gate.

ACCEPTANCE

- Inspect the landed provider API against the accepted semantics; record any deltas before adapting.
- Add no duplicate semantic ADT or fallback inference in StoryAtlas.
- Update storyatlas4sRevision to the exact reachable provider commit and keep sibling ProjectRef direction one-way.
- Adapt the CLI/app/publication compiler through a narrow provider boundary while preserving partial successes when one output role fails, if that is the provider contract.
- Add consumer compilation, determinism, identity, provenance, missingness, and malformed-boundary tests.
- Pass compileAll, testAll, scalafmtCheckAll, app/fastLinkJS, relevant browser courts, and the static-preview contract.
- Record local SHA, pinned provider SHA, and remote reachability separately.

WAITING IS LOCALIZED

This bead may wait on the provider candidate. The static preview, relation comparison, mockup repair, accessibility courts, and Intaglio consumer evaluation can proceed independently.
set.title: Adopt the durable storymodel4s output contract and update the immutable pin
